text: Robotic indoor-farming darling that raised $98M+ on a 'redesigning agriculture' pitch. Now flagged Inactive on YC's directory after two layoff rounds gutted the company. Pitched mixed human/robot greenhouses growing leafy greens and berries. Raised $53M Series C in September 2021 led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures. November 2022: Iron Ox laid off ~50 of 100 staff — half the company in a single round — citing macro headwinds. January 2025 brought a second round of layoffs to 'extend cash runway' . Rebranded to Inevitable Tech. YC directory currently lists status as Inactive. Indoor-farming robotics joined the list of well-funded categories that didn't outrun the unit economics. Satirical project. Not affiliated with Y Combinator. All information from public records.
